rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for extending a period or duration.

example.english: We want to prolong the lease.
example.traditional: 我哋想同業主商量延長租約。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 tung4 jip6 zyu2 soeng1 loeng4 jin4 coeng4 zou1 joek3

rows.note: Use this mainly when making a physical object or measurable length longer.

example.english: The rope is too short, so we need to prolong it a little before we can use it.
example.traditional: 條繩唔夠長，要拉長少少先夠用。
example.jyutping: tiu4 sing4 m4 gau3 coeng4 jiu3 laai1 coeng4 siu2 siu2 sin1 gau3 jung6

rows.note: Use this when delaying an action or decision, especially with an unwanted or deliberate sense.

example.english: Don’t prolong the decision any further; we have to decide today.
example.traditional: 你唔好再拖延啦，今日一定要決定。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 jin4 laa1 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 kyut3 ding6
